thread:
jamie: FYI noticed token-level jitter when priming atlas-13B-int4 on long prompts (approx >2k tokens). Outputs diverge mid-prefill; seems tied to async prefetch + streaming.

sara: can you paste minimal repro + which model/quant config? :eyes: 

jamie: Repro steps:
```
./run_infer --model atlas-13b-int4 --prompt-file tests/long_warp.txt --prefetch=async --batch-size=1 --rope-rescale=auto --seed=42
```
Logs show:
```
KV_INDEX: expect=2050 actual=2046   # at token offset 2050
TRACE: prefetch_thread=3 overlap=true
```
I see divergence between int4 and int8 runs.

kevin: @jamie do you have a short prompt that triggers it? can you try --prefetch=off and --rope-rescale=none?

jamie: yes short prompt attached (first 2200 tokens of dataset) — with --prefetch=off the reproducer drops from 8/8 to 1/8 (still fails once). With --rope-rescale=none it fails 0/8.

alice: hmm that suggests either async prefetch races with kv-window growth or our rope rescale path mutates the kv pointers. Did you run with kv-checksum enabled?

jamie: ran with --kv-checksum on, checksum mismatch at the same offset. sample diff:
```
-token: "the"
+token: "a"
kv_hash_pre=0x7f3a
kv_hash_post=0x7f1b
```

ci-bot: CI: queued longprefill-flaky for rerun -> https://ci.internal/runs/atlas-prefill-4212340000

sara: assign bisect to @kevin — try turning off quant-blocking and toggling block_size 128/256. Also run with CPU fallback (int8 simulation) to rule out kernel bug.

kevin: starting a sweep: block_size=[64,128,256], prefetch=[on,off], rope=[auto,none], seed=[42,7]. I'll post results in this thread.

kevin: quick update: block_size=128 + prefetch=on + rope=auto reproduces 8/8. Changing rope=none fixed. quant block size didn't change repro frequency much.

sara: good catch. sounds like rope-rescale path is introducing non-determinism when prefetch overlaps. Punting to ML runtime team for a small patch: add locking around kv-growth + rope-rescale.

alice: agree. can we add a regression test in eng-ml/long-prefill-suite with --rope-rescale=auto + prefetch=on and assert kv-checksum stable across seeds? add flaky threshold 0/8.

jamie: creating test ticket: TICKET-4421. Adding logs + minimal prompt. tagging @kevin for rollout canary.

kevin: will craft a minimal patch to lock kv-growth and run a 100-run stress on Dedicated QA. ETA EOD tomorrow.

jamie: thanks all :thumbsup:

sara: follow-up: schedule canary and add to flaky list if fixed. otherwise escalate to infra.
